differing_components.why: RTK has an exact artifact reduction pair of 537 -> 178 tokens (docs/token-practice.md line 107). Its clean-token-tool-ci decision passed 41 command expectations and 14 fidelity/recovery checks with matching hashes (catalogs/foundation/decisions.json lines 1472-1502; docs/full-stack-convergence.md lines 132-137). It is core with an accepted use stage (docs/token-native-saturation.md line 109). B excludes it over the failed gateway previews, but that limitation (decisions.json line 1166) is in the selected-context-processing decision, which lists both context-mode and rtk as components (lines 1150-1153), so it applies to Context Mode as well.

Context Mode has native use and restart evidence (docs/token-native-saturation.md lines 18 and 73) and a real extraction (native-client-results.json lines 166-181). It has 0 retained artifact pairs, and its fixed-order paired trials conflict: Codex 11.26% lower, Claude 25.83% higher (docs/token-practice.md lines 85-86). Its stats mix unrelated scopes (native-client-results.json line 12; docs/full-stack-convergence.md lines 140-141). The evidence does not show it meets the recoverable-original and separate-measurement requirement as well as RTK.

judgments.why:
The two sets share Headroom (c5) and ccusage (c1). They differ only on RTK (c4, which only A picks) and Context Mode (c3, which only B picks). The requirement is useful context with recoverable originals, plus artifact reductions measured separately from provider usage.

RTK has direct retained evidence for both parts:
- An exact o200k_base artifact pair of 537 -> 178 tokens (docs/token-practice.md line 107).
- Clean local and GitHub installs that passed 41 command expectations and 14 fidelity/recovery checks (catalogs/foundation/decisions.json lines 1472-1502; docs/full-stack-convergence.md lines 132-137, "41 native commands, 14 checks").

Context Mode's evidence is weaker on both parts:
- It has 0 retained artifact pairs (docs/token-native-saturation.md line 73).
- Its only measured usage pairs point in opposite directions: Codex -11.26% and Claude +25.83% (docs/token-practice.md lines 85-86).
- Its ctx_stats "contain inconsistent session narratives and include cumulative unrelated scopes" (evidence/artifacts/full-stack-convergence-20260921/native-client-results.json line 12; docs/full-stack-convergence.md lines 140-141). That makes separate measurement harder.

B's native-client extraction is real: the ctx_execute_file result at lines 166-181 found "Application checks | Not configured". But it is only a use-stage observation.

B's reason for leaving out RTK is that the gateway RTK/lite previews failed. That limitation sits in the selected-context-processing decision, which lists both context-mode and rtk as components (decisions.json lines 1150-1153 and 1166). So the same reason applies equally to the Context Mode component B selected.

A's set therefore drops nothing the evidence better supports. B swaps a component with measured artifact and fidelity evidence for one without it. Neither set contains a claim the evidence contradicts, so "neither" does not apply.

A and B agree on Headroom (c5) and ccusage (c1). They differ on one slot: A picks Context Mode (c3) and B picks RTK (c4). The requirement asks for useful context with recoverable originals, and for artifact reductions measured separately from provider usage. RTK has retained evidence for both parts; Context Mode does not.

RTK recovery: in evidence/receipts/native-token-ci-github-20260920.json, the "rtk-raw-recovery" step (`rtk proxy git log -2`) has stdout_raw_sha256 9578f8b7…, the same hash as the raw git log output. The filtered "rtk-git-log" step returns the shorter form.

RTK reduction: docs/token-practice.md line 107 records an exact o200k_base artifact pair of 537 -> 178 tokens. Line 103 says these counts are artifact counts, not whole-task or billed usage. catalogs/foundation/decisions.json lines 1472-1494 (clean-token-tool-ci) records clean local and GitHub installs passing forty-one command expectations and fourteen fidelity/recovery checks.

Context Mode: the extra evidence A cites is one native ctx_execute_file extraction in evidence/artifacts/full-stack-convergence-20260921/native-client-results.json (lines 166-181). That same file also shows a native `rtk git log -6` call succeeding (line 116), so it does not favour Context Mode over RTK. It shows no recovery of an exact original. Line 12 of that file also says Context Mode stats "contain inconsistent session narratives and include cumulative unrelated scopes". docs/token-practice.md lines 83-92 records the paired trials: Claude went up 25.83% and Codex went down 11.26%, and the doc calls the result non-causal. No exact artifact-reduction pair for Context Mode is retained there (lines 105-116).

Both components share the selected-context-processing decision (decisions.json lines 1140-1166). That decision records the RTK gateway/lite preview failure, and B lists it as an open gap. Neither set makes a claim the evidence contradicts, but B's set is better supported.

method: anonymous A/B adjudication: one evidence-reviewer judge and two evidence-reviewer refuters (Opus 5.5, high) per presentation order, lane identities scrubbed from the returns; judgments lists each order's pick (workflows wf_3e94965e-141 and wf_53dd768b-bff)
